notes.title: The patch notes for the 1.2.16 version
notes.notes: [p]The list of chnages:[/p][list][*][p][i]The ending credits have been edited;[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]The heights of the Latin letters c, ć, ĉ, č, ç, ȼ, ḉ; and the heights of the Cyrillic letters с, ҫ, э, ӭ, and є have been fixed;[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]The widths of the Cyrillic letters ұ and ү have been fixed;[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]The spaces after the dot and the comma have been fixed;[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]The authors' names of the game in the ending credits were translater into Tåtar/Tatar language;[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Added the kerning after the Cyrillic letters Ң, А, Ә, Б, В, Г, Д, Ж, Җ, З, К, Л, М, О, Ө, Р, С, Т, У, Ү, Ф, Х, Һ, Ц, Щ, Ъ, Ь, Э, Ю, ә, б, в, г, д, е, ё, ж, җ, з, к, л, ң, о, ө, р, с, т, у, ү, ф, х, ц, ъ, ь, and э;[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Added the kerning after the Latin letters A, B, C, D, I, J, K, L, M, O, P, R, S, T, U, V, W, X, Y, and Z;[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]And some minor improvements.[/i][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The update of the version 1.2.
notes.notes: [h2][b]The patch notes for the 1.2 version:              [/b]ːsteamhappyː[/h2][list][*][p]Added the Kazakh localization;[/p][/*][*][p]Added the Brazilian Portuguese localization;[/p][/*][*][p]Added the Turkish localization;[/p][/*][*][p]Added the Ukrainian localization;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some mistakes in the Tåtar(officially Tatar) localization;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some mistakes in the Russian localization;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some mistakes in the English localization;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some mistakes in the Nёw Englīš localization;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wrong position of the trigger of the buttons "Buy the car", "Choose the car", and "Tune the chosen car";[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed color of the text "Fullscreen" so that it is better seen;[/p][/*][*][p]Removed trees stricking out from the road;[/p][/*][*][p]Added the Input System which allows a better support of controllers;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the checkpoints because of which a car was respawned under the ground in the 17th and 18th races;[/p][/*][*][p]Added the checkpoints' bounds, so that there is a smaller chance to miss one;[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246694/854c268cdc73c12971a69ba6f12e2ad450209e4f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246694/78a219be67102f940064dbf540f2fe32369aad71.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Added a new car: Azatlığıbız;[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246694/f60ab62224772f2e0dd68fb70b4cc1922572e5fc.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Replaced the old cursor with the new one;[/p][/*][*][p]And small changes.[/p][/*][/list]
